transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... I guess I'm just here because things have been kind of difficult lately at work. I just... I keep beating myself up. I got this senior analyst role a while back, and I just keep thinking I'm not really senior material. Like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. It's just... it's been hard to shake that feeling.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge when you're at work or thinking about work?
Not really. I don't know if nervous is the right word. I'm not... on edge or anything. I just... I just think about how I shouldn't be in the role. That's pretty much it.
Do you ever feel sad or empty outside of thinking about your job?

I guess... yeah. It's not just the job. Most days lately, I just have this... I don't know, this heavy feeling. Just kind of low. Like I'm just going through the motions at work and at home, and... I don't know, it's just like the color is turned down on everything.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like, such as hobbies or spending time with friends and family, as much as you used to?

I don't know. Not really, I guess. I usually... I usually like to grill on the weekends, or maybe go fishing. Put on a record. But lately... I don't know, the stuff just sits there. I just don't really care to do any of it.
Do you often worry about things that are not related to your job?
No. Not really. I mean... no more than anyone else, I guess. I don't really sit around worrying about things.
Have you noticed a decrease in pleasure from activities that you normally find enjoyable?
Yeah. I mean... like I just said a minute ago. With the grilling and all that. I just don't really get anything out of it right now.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?

I guess so. My belt is a little looser lately... not that I'm trying to lose weight or anything. I just haven't had much of an appetite. I usually just grab a few bites here and there, or... I don't know, just skip supper.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to be alive or of harming yourself?

I mean... no. I haven't made any kind of plan to hurt myself or anything. I wouldn't do that. Just... I don't know. I guess sometimes I catch myself thinking it might just be easier if I didn't wake up some morning. But... yeah, I wouldn't actually do anything.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... maybe about a month or so, I guess. That's when... well, they asked me to cover some of the senior analyst duties at work. Ever since then, it's just been... I don't know, kind of this up-and-down pattern.
Have you experienced any periods of at least two weeks where you felt better and your low mood lifted?

Um... maybe. I don't really track the days. Just... looking back on it, these low periods... feeling guilty or whatever... they've kind of been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now, I guess.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?
No. I've never... no, nothing like that.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are not your own or that someone or something is controlling your mind?
No. I... no, nothing like that. They're just my own thoughts.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt completely back to normal?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
Not really. I mean... I usually look forward to grilling on the weekend, or fishing. Maybe putting on a record. But lately... I don't know. I just leave the stuff sitting there. I don't really care.
Have you had any periods in the past month where your low mood significantly improved for a few days?
No... not really. It's just been pretty much the same.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you didn't feel low at all?
No... not really. Most days lately, I just have this... heavy, low feeling. Like I'm just moving through work and being at home, but... the color's turned down. It's just been like that.
Have you had any days in the past week where your low mood lifted for most of the day?
No. Not that I can think of. It's just been... more of the same, really.
Have you had any days in the past month where you woke up feeling okay, but then your mood worsened as the day went on?
No... I don't think so. Usually, when I wake up, it's... it's already just kind of heavy. I don't really get that okay feeling in the mornings to begin with.
Do you usually feel this low mood throughout the entire day, or are there times during the day when it feels a little better?
Not really... it's pretty much just the whole day. I haven't really noticed it getting any better at certain times, it just... stays like that.
Does your low mood ever feel like it gets a little better at any point during the day?
No... like I just said, I don't really think so. It pretty much just stays the same.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a persistent low mood, loss of interest in activities, decreased appetite, and feelings of worthlessness, which have been ongoing for at least two weeks. While the patient reports some variability in mood, the overall pattern suggests a depressive episode that does not meet the full criteria for a major depressive episode (F32.0) due to the lack of clear evidence for at least five symptoms, including either depressed mood or loss of interest in activities, and the duration being at least two weeks but with some fluctuations. Other specified depressive disorder (F32.8) is the most appropriate diagnosis given the presence of depressive symptoms that cause significant distress or impairment but do not meet the full criteria for a major depressive episode or other specified depressive disorders.
